title: Escapes Home and Meets Rat
description: Cleans his house, then impulsively leaves to explore outdoors, meets Water Rat by a riverbank, and goes boating.

title: Meets Toad
description: Asks Rat to introduce him to Toad, who shows off his new caravan for traveling.

title: Explores the Wild Wood Alone
description: Decides to explore the Wild Wood alone despite Rat's discouragement, enters the forest and feels increasingly threatened.

title: Seeks Shelter with Badger
description: With Rat, seeks shelter from a snowstorm in the Wild Wood and knocks on Badger's door for help.

title: Returns Home
description: Returns home after a day out hunting and exploring, senses his old home nearby but is left alone in the road.

title: Prepares for Boating Season
description: Helps forcibly remove Toad's motor-clothes after he refuses and listens to Badger lecture Toad.

title: Searches for Portly
description: Decides not to sleep but to help search for Otter's son Portly by boat along the river during a moonlit night.

title: Toad Escapes Prison
description: Not directly involved, but Toad's escape is mentioned as he regains confidence and talks about his animal friends.

title: Observes Autumn Migration
description: No direct actions, but observes the onset of autumn and departure of various creatures from their summer homes.

title: Toad Returns Home
description: Rescued by Rat, feels remorseful after learning about the takeover of Toad Hall.

title: Reclaims Toad Hall
description: Equipped with weapons by Rat, enters a secret passage under the riverbank and helps overpower Weasels in Toad Hall.

title: Restores Order in Toad Hall
description: Chases after sentry stoats while Badger directs others to restore order in Toad Hall.
